heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15210636:4102.Nov. 14, 1988, Pub. L. 100–655, § 102, 102 Stat. 3849. The words “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
